shapeSummary: Flat aluminum round-end plate, 152 x 32 x 2.5 mm. Length is along X, width along Z, and thickness runs along Y from 0 to 2.5. Both ends are full 16 mm radius. Six 14 mm through-holes sit on the centerline at a 24 mm pitch (x = ±12, ±36, ±60).
warnings: The small 16mm-pattern holes and slots around each 14mm hole are visible, but their diameters and coordinates are not stated, so they were omitted.
Dimensions come from the unverified spec. The 24mm pitch is derived as (152-32)/5.
Axes follow the prompt rules: thickness along Y with the bottom at Y=0, X and Z centered. This differs from the analysis JSON, which put thickness along Z.
cadquery:
part = cq.Workplane('XZ').slot2D(152, 32).extrude(-2.5)
holes = cq.Workplane('XZ').pushPoints([(x, 0) for x in (-60, -36, -12, 12, 36, 60)]).circle(7).extrude(-2.5)
part = part.cut(holes)
